theorems.name: Submission.br_local_finite_mass_extension
theorems.statement: SlicingTheorem → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball x₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity X ∧ X.mass < ∞ ∧ X.boundary.mass < ∞ ∧ ∀ η : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball x₀ r → X (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) (m + 1) η) = T η
